instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: This study cannot show that higher income changed a person's personality. It also cannot show that their personality made their income rise. Something else may have played a part in both. Even when researchers follow the same people and compare them carefully, this alone cannot show what caused what. In other words, this is not a how-to guide for a personality that earns more. This study can give you a reason to open again a book you were about to close. You may have thought, this is just the kind of person I am. Instead of ending with, that person is the kind who earns a lot, you can look back and ask, how have I changed? You may plan to flip through a book about successful people. Then you may realize you are reading the next part of your own story. That is what makes this study interesting.
